object_description: well-proportioned three-storey building with offset levels
design_condition: The building is positioned to reinforce the paved playground as the center, connect smoothly to park-like open spaces, and follow the raised edge of the existing main building with an arcade and split-level entrances.

positive.statement: The three-storey, well-proportioned building integrates into the existing complex and creates appropriate open spaces.

position.rationale: Compact stepped three-storey mass and surrounding open-space edges are clearly visible across all calibrated views.

positive.statement: The upper-floor arrangement of classrooms, stairs and atriums is simple and clear.

position.rationale: Upper level is constrained by repeated elevation bands and the stepped upper footprint.

positive.statement: The staircase connected to the atriums creates identity and meets the fire-protection requirements.

position.rationale: Stair and atrium locations are approximated centrally because interior voids are not directly exposed.

positive.statement: The atriums and anterooms basically enable an expansion of lessons, with the anterooms particularly suitable for exhibitions and gatherings.

position.rationale: Interior gathering zones are assigned within the compact central mass without distinguishable room geometry.

positive.statement: The compact organization and simple supporting structure are expected to be very cost-effective.

position.rationale: Compact massing and regular horizontal structural bands are evident throughout the model.

positive.statement: The outdoor spaces are appropriately sized and well designed.

position.rationale: Open areas are visible around the compact footprint, especially along the southern and western edges.

negative.statement: The staggered entrances create floor-level shifts that lead to spatial and operational complications.

position.rationale: Entrances are not individually visible; the southern edge provides the directional approximation.

negative.statement: Several rooms have low heights that are not approvable and are not reasonable.

position.rationale: Low rooms are approximated on a lower level because internal heights cannot be resolved directly.

negative.statement: The anterooms are only of limited suitability for group work because stair access passes through them and creates disruption potential.

position.rationale: Anterooms are assigned to a representative internal circulation zone not distinguishable in the exterior sample.

negative.statement: The offset hinders internal relationships more than it adds value, despite producing economically interesting compactness.

position.rationale: The stepped offset is directly visible in the footprint and elevation bands, supporting a building-level anchor.

negative.statement: The massive architectural expression is hardly able to create an appropriate dialogue with the slenderness and delicacy of the existing architecture.

position.rationale: Broad repeated facade bands present a substantial exterior expression visible in the elevations.

negative.statement: Despite good external-space conditions, the building appears too independent and does not sufficiently complement and strengthen the existing ensemble.

position.rationale: The compact standalone mass is clearly legible as a distinct building form.
